items.title: Could SPAM Hot Honey’s Brand Refresh Strategy Reveal a New Consumer Playbook for Hormel (HRL)?
items.summary: Hormel Foods has launched SPAM Hot Honey as a full-time flavor, partnering with Brooklyn’s Win Son Bakery on limited-time menu items, co-branded streetwear-style merchandise, and broader retail distribution across select US grocery stores. items.title: Hormel Foods (HRL): Buy, Sell, or Hold Post Q2 Earnings?
items.summary: Over the past six months, Hormel Foods’s stock price fell to $20.86. Shareholders have lost 8% of their capital, which is disappointing considering the S&P 500 has climbed by 13.7%. This was partly due to its softer quarterly results and may have investors wondering how to approach the situation.
